messages.content:
The failure occurs in the `testLongLineChunkingIndentIgnored` test method of the `BugCLI162Test` class. The test sets up some options with a long description, creates a `HelpFormatter` instance, and then calls `printHelp` method to generate a help message. The failure indicates that the `HelpFormatter` goes into an infinite loop when there is not enough space to display a word on a single line, leading to a `OutOfMemoryError`.

By looking at the code snippet for the `printHelp` method in the `HelpFormatter` class, we can see that it delegates the wrapping to another method called `findWrapPos` to determine where to wrap the text. The `findWrapPos` method searches for the last whitespace character before the given position and uses it as the wrap position.

The issue is likely related to the logic in the `findWrapPos` method. If there is no whitespace character before the specified position to wrap the text, the method will keep searching forward until the end of the text, potentially causing an infinite loop if there is no whitespace character to be found.

To fix the issue, the `findWrapPos` method needs additional logic to handle cases where there are no suitable wrap positions before the specified position, potentially introducing a maximum number of iterations or a way to break out of the loop under certain conditions.

Here are the methods that should be fixed:
- `org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter.findWrapPos(java.lang.String, int, int)`

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
